$comment: Profile definitions for setup.mjs. Globs relative to payload/. exclude wins over include; extends unions the parent chain's exclude first. optional groups are promoted over exclude when active.
$marketplaces: Where each managed plugin's marketplace comes from, so setup.mjs can register it before installing - `claude plugin install` fails outright against an unknown marketplace. Sources are transcribed from a real ~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json, not guessed; a marketplace with no entry here produces a note telling the human to add one, never an invented repo. This gap predates the fork: the four pre-fork plugins live in marketplaces that any machine which ran the bootstrap already has, so nothing ever tripped it.
$gsd: `gsd` stays in managedPlugins but appears in no profile, so plugin-reconcile prints its uninstall command rather than its install command. GSD-Core is installed with npx, not from a marketplace, and the marketplace plugin of that name was never what this bundle wanted - it was carried in the full profile by inheritance. Removing the entry entirely would be quieter but weaker: a plugin nobody manages is a plugin nobody offers to remove, and a machine that already has it would keep it forever without ever being told.
$context7: In managedPlugins, in no profile: plugin-reconcile prints its uninstall command. Context7 is reached through its MCP server.
$keepInstalled: Managed plugins that are disabled when not required, but never uninstalled. superpowers is here because ultrapowers is our fork of it: keeping upstream on disk makes rollback one command (re-enable it, disable the fork) instead of a reinstall from the marketplace. It must stay in managedPlugins to be disabled at all - a plugin we stop managing is a plugin we stop turning off. Both enabled at once is NOT the fallback: they share 14 skill names and that is undocumented behaviour we do not run in production. ultrapowers is here for `lite`, which ships it to disk but does not enable it.

optional.$comment: Excluded by default, promotable at install time via setup.mjs. When active, globs win over exclude and files are installed (pruned again on opt-out).
